total_model.summary: Model projects 54.0 total points (DAL 25, SF 29). Biggest factors: Combined quarterback ratings (raises total 3.1), Combined offense EPA/play (last 8 games) (raises total 2.9), Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 1.8). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
